answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10099 Country: India Title: Is it true that the Salah(Prayer) offered by a person gets damaged if a woman suddenly comes in his sight? If it true, please mention whether is there any exception for any woman(eg. Mahram-like mother, wife etc.)? Is it valid for each part of the woman's body or feet/legs are exempted? Question: Is it true that the Salah(Prayer) offered by a person gets damaged if a woman suddenly comes in his sight? If it true, please mention whether is there any exception for any woman(eg. Mahram-like mother, wife etc.)? Is it valid for each part of the woman's body or feet/legs are exempted? Answer ID: 10099 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 63/63=M/1429) No, it is not right, only by passing of women the salah is not nullified, whatever woman she is. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
